scope: Static-site generation, localhost preview server, CLI integration, package inclusion, and unchanged mathematical/observer contracts.

local_environment.matplotlib: not installed; optional static-export test skipped

web_security_observations: Preview responses send Cache-Control: no-store, X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff, and Referrer-Policy: no-referrer.
Landing-page labels and titles are HTML-escaped; workbench data remains JSON payload.
Site generation embeds no timestamp, host path, random value, CDN, telemetry, or account dependency.

browser_acceptance.reason: The workbench front-end implementation file is unchanged in this increment; only generated version labels change through the renderer. Existing 0.2.0 Chromium evidence is retained without being relabeled as a 0.3.0 browser certification.

limits: Native iOS Safari and physical touch hardware were not tested.
The preview server is a research convenience, not a production web server.
Repository-wide CI was not run in the local verification environment.
The optional Matplotlib static-export test was skipped because the dependency was unavailable.
